title: Elderberry Wine
statementMd:
Jeanne and her son Semi-Demi-John are engaged in the elderberry-wine making business.

The recipe requires, aside from a closely-guarded secret quantity of the letter $r$, strict proportions of $12$ parts fresh elderberries, $12$ parts brewing sugar, and $40$ parts water. As long as one or more ingredients are lacking, the team will place an order for as much extra as needed to make up the weight, and start again.

For instance:

- If they have $18$kg of elderberries, $9$kg of sugar, and $100$kg of water, they can use $9$kg of elderberries, all $9$kg of the sugar, and $30$kg of the water and then they are stuck.
- They must then order $9$kg more of sugar in order to proceed and use $9$kg, $9$kg, and $30$kg again.
- After this they must order $12$kg each of elderberries and sugar in order to finally use $12$kg, $12$kg, and $40$kg of elderberries, sugar, and water respectively.

| **Phase** | **Eb (kg)** | **Su (kg)** | **$H_{2}O$ (kg)** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Initial Stock | 18 | 9 | 100 |
| First Brewing Run | -9 | -9 | -30 |
| Remaining Stock (Stuck) | 9 | 0 | 70 |
| Sugar Order | 0 | +9 | 0 |
| Stock After First Order | 9 | 9 | 70 |
| Second Brewing Run | -9 | -9 | -30 |
| Remaining Stock (Stuck) | 0 | 0 | 40 |
| Berry + Sugar Order | +12 | +12 | 0 |
| Stock After Second Order | 12 | 12 | 40 |
| Final Brewing Run | -12 | -12 | -40 |

## Input

The input consists of one line containing three floating-point numbers $a$, $b$, $c$ ($0 \le a, b, c \le 10^{16}$): the number of kilograms of elderberries, sugar, and water respectively.

## Output

Output three floating-point numbers $a'$ $b'$ $c'$ giving the cumulative total quantities of elderberries, sugar, and water that will be ordered respectively.

The output must be accurate to an absolute or relative error of $10^{-6}$.
statementZhMd:
Jeanne 和她的儿子 Semi-Demi-John 从事接骨木果酒酿造生意。

配方除了需要加入用量严格保密的字母 𝑟r 外，还要求严格按照 1212 份新鲜接骨木果、1212 份酿酒用糖和 4040 份水的比例配制。只要有一种或多种原料不足，他们就会下单购买恰好足以补足所需重量的原料，然后继续酿造。

例如：

- 如果他们有 1818kg 接骨木果、99kg 糖和 100100kg 水，那么他们可以使用 99kg 接骨木果、全部 99kg 糖和 3030kg 水，随后就无法继续酿造了。
- 接着，他们必须再订购 99kg 糖，才能继续酿造，并再次分别使用 99kg、99kg 和 3030kg 的三种原料。
- 此后，他们必须各订购 1212kg 接骨木果和糖，才能最终分别用掉 1212kg 接骨木果、1212kg 糖和 4040kg 水。

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含三个浮点数 𝑎a、𝑏b、𝑐c（0≤𝑎,𝑏,𝑐≤10160≤a,b,c≤1016），分别表示接骨木果、糖和水的千克数。

## 输出格式

输出三个浮点数 𝑎′a′ 𝑏′b′ 𝑐′c′，分别表示整个过程中累计订购的接骨木果、糖和水的总量。

输出的绝对误差或相对误差不得超过 10−610−6。
